subject: Gate change and train delay for Thursday
text: The 6:10 shuttle from the student dorm to the airport will still leave on time, but I just got the alert saying our return flight from Cleveland is delayed by two hours, so our original 9:45 pickup window at the library parking lot may not work. I have already asked the department office to move our hotel checkout to 11:00, since the new arrival time gives us more time to get back without rushing before the evening study session. If the delay stretches longer overnight, I would rather take the later train instead of trying to catch the earlier one from the station, because I do not want us to miss our reserved seats and then have to stand in line again. I will keep checking the airline app and the campus shuttle page. If either changes before midnight, I will text you. For now, the plan is unchanged: bring your presentation folder, one small bag, and a copy of the bus confirmation, and meet at the main steps at 5:50 sharp so we do not need to search for each other.
